headline: Deploy instantly to a single workspace or enable unlisted distribution for external users, but expect strict guidelines and up to a 10-week wait for Marketplace listing.
summary: Slack supports rapid development within an initial workspace and provides Unlisted Public Distribution for immediate multi-tenant OAuth access. However, getting listed in the Slack Marketplace requires proving active usage across at least 10 workspaces, passing strict security and AI usage guidelines, and completing a functional review that takes up to 10 weeks.
approval_wait: Instant for Unlisted Public Distribution; up to 10 weeks for Marketplace Functional Review.

oauth.pkce: Supported (SHA-256) and mandatory for custom URI schemes. Enabling PKCE in app settings is an irreversible one-way action.
oauth.refresh_tokens: Supported. By default, access tokens are long-lived, but enabling token rotation (irreversible) expires them in 12 hours. Refresh tokens are single-use.
oauth.redirect_uri_rules: Must enforce HTTPS (except localhost) and cannot contain URL fragments (#). The runtime redirect_uri must strictly match a pre-configured URL.
oauth.scopes: Separated into bot (scope) and user (user_scope) scopes. Sign In With Slack (OpenID Connect) requires separate OAuth flows from standard API scopes.

steps.title: Create Slack App
steps.detail: Register the app in the Developer Portal and select an initial development workspace.

steps.title: Install to Workspace
steps.detail: Use the 'Install App to Workspace' button to generate a long-lived access token for the development workspace immediately.

steps.title: Configure App Details
steps.detail: Set up OAuth settings, ensure all endpoints use HTTPS, and publish a compliant Privacy Policy.

steps.title: Activate Distribution
steps.detail: Enable Public Distribution in the App Dashboard to generate shareable installation URLs and enable multi-tenant OAuth.

steps.title: Achieve Active Usage Minimum
steps.detail: Acquire active installations in at least 10 different workspaces over the prior 28 days.

steps.title: Submit Application and Demo
steps.detail: Provide a 30-90 second demo video and populated test credentials for the review team.

steps.title: Preliminary and Functional Review
steps.detail: Wait up to 10 business days for metadata feedback and up to 10 weeks for full functional and security review.

requirements.text: All public-facing endpoints (OAuth Redirect URLs, interactive Request URLs, Events API endpoints) must enforce HTTPS/SSL.
Apps must host a public Privacy Policy specifying data practices, retention periods, deletion mechanisms, and a direct contact email or form.
Marketplace listing strictly requires the app to be actively used in at least 10 active workspaces prior to submission.
AI apps must show typing indicators during response generation and include clear hallucination disclaimers.
Apps are strictly prohibited from using Slack message data to train Large Language Models.
Desktop and custom URI redirects using PKCE cannot request bot scopes, only user scopes.

gotchas.text: Enabling token rotation or PKCE in the app settings is a permanent, irreversible action.
Sign In With Slack (OpenID Connect) scopes cannot be combined with standard API scopes in the same OAuth redirect.
Failing the 10-business-day preliminary Marketplace review resets your place in the queue.
Apps lacking immediate onboarding instructions or welcome messages upon installation face rejection.
Once published in the Marketplace, app configurations are locked, requiring developers to use a separate staging app and endure another 6-10 week review for updates.
Reviewers frequently reject apps if commands crash when run in channels where the bot has not been explicitly invited.

blockers.issue: Cannot submit to Marketplace due to the 10-workspace minimum pre-check.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Activate Unlisted Public Distribution to onboard external beta customers via OAuth until reaching 10 active workspaces, then submit.

blockers.issue: App rejected during review for over-permissioning.
blockers.how_to_proceed: Remove overly broad scopes (like search:read or admin.*) and ensure every requested scope is visibly utilized in the provided demo video.

agent_can: Draft a compliant Privacy Policy and data retention disclosure.
Configure OAuth endpoints and verify HTTPS compliance.
Implement the OAuth 2.0 flow, including PKCE code challenge and token rotation logic.
Add typing indicators and AI disclaimers to comply with Marketplace guidelines.
you_must: Register the application in the Developer Portal and select a development workspace.
Activate Unlisted Public Distribution or achieve 10 active workspace installs for Marketplace submission.
Record a 30-90 second end-to-end demo video for the functional review process.
Provide trial accounts populated with dummy data for the Slack review team.

key_claims.text: Unlisted Public Distribution enables multi-tenant OAuth for external workspaces immediately without a security audit.
Slack operates distinct token endpoints for standard OAuth and OpenID Connect (OIDC).
The authorize endpoint correctly returns error hints for invalid client IDs.
The temporary OAuth authorization code expires after 10 minutes.

open_questions: Can an app smoothly transition from Unlisted Distribution to Marketplace listed without prompting existing users to re-authenticate?
What are the specific triggers for Enterprise Grid admin consent workflows during individual workspace installations?
